title: PCP Critical User Flows
description: Cross-module end-to-end journeys spanning the program objective -- distinct from any single module's own acceptance criteria, which never see past their own module boundary. Walked for real by flow_wiring.py's CTRL-040 wave-merge check once every module a flow spans has completed.

base_url.description: Default base URL every flow's relative step targets resolve against (e.g. a local dev server or preview deploy). A flow's own base_url, if set, overrides this.

modules_spanned.description: Every module this journey touches. The flow only runs once ALL of these are complete.

target.description: For navigate: a path or URL. For click/fill/submit/assert_visible: a CSS selector. For assert_text: a CSS selector whose innerText must contain `value`.

value.description: Text to type (fill) or to search for (assert_text). Ignored by other actions.
